routes.description: Ground the request, close material decisions, produce a complete plan, and wait for an explicit handoff.

steps.description: Ground, clarify, design, and present the plan without changing the target environment.
steps.instructions: Use the startplan-core Ground, Intent, and Implementation phases. Read before asking; ask only about material undiscoverable choices. Before presenting exactly one complete <proposed_plan> block, complete this step with outcome plan_ready and concrete evidence. Never implement during this step.
